Name designs

Two designs for each of the 23 names, 46 in all. Each is built in the manner of four pins from the board and sits above them. The outlined pin is the one it follows most closely.

  • Colors are sampled from the reference pins.
  • Layout proportions were read off the outlined pin.
  • Typefaces are the nearest open-source faces. Each caption names the face and says where the reference uses something else.
  • Photographs are crops of pins 094, 097 and 184. They stand in for new photography.
  • The match was judged by eye, side by side. No pixel-difference figure was computed.

Kitchen Alchemy

The hero moment of this product happens in the pot: a 60-second magic trick when our package hits hot water, transforming into a velvety, aromatic meal. This territory captures that unexpected culinary metamorphosis with a sense of pure wonder.

Gosh

An exclamation of astonishment and wonder. Reminiscent of delicious words like nosh and goulash too.

Soft serif, outlined and tilted Follows pin 141: lettering, "Go for it!". Also drawn from 003, 213, 266.

Caprasimo with an outline and a pink second plate. The pink was matched by eye.

Blob wordmark on yellow Follows pin 229: yellowbird wordmark, black on yellow, on a slant. Also drawn from 230, 124, 154.

Modak. The reference is custom lettering.

Abra

The first two syllables of abracadabra, it channels magical transformation while remaining ownable and memorable.

Script on green Follows pin 017: methin typeface promo. Also drawn from 211, 150, 016.

Yellowtail. The reference is a specimen for a script typeface.

Wide caps on food Follows pin 094: "Tomato, la casa de la pasta" wordmark on sauce. Also drawn from 304, 305, 090.

Unbounded 500. The photograph is a crop of pin 094 or pin 097.

All Together Now

With this product, there’s no separation between the package and the meal—everything goes in and everything melts together. This territory celebrates the joyful fusion inside the pot, where pouch, water, and ingredients blend into one rich, comforting bowl. It also nods to the sense of togetherness in sharing a meal.

Delicious Ritual

This territory spotlights the radically simple kitchen behavior our product unlocks: one clever little parcel you drop straight into the pot, stir, and eat in minutes. Here the act of making a meal becomes a fun, whimsical routine you look forward to.
